adjacency_path = 'chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv'

# Read the datasets
bike_data = pd.read_csv(data_path)
adjacency_data = pd.read_csv(adjacency_path)

# Data Preparation
# Count the number of trips that started in each borough (Departures)
departures = bike_data['StartBorough'].value_counts()

# Count the number of self-contained trips (Self-contained trips)
self_contained_trips = bike_data[bike_data['StartBorough'] == bike_data['EndBorough']].groupby('StartBorough').size()

# Count total trips ending in each borough
total_trips_ending = bike_data['EndBorough'].value_counts()

# Calculate Arrival share
total_trips = bike_data.shape[0]
arrival_share = total_trips_ending / total_trips

# Calculate Expected self-contained trips
expected_self_contained_trips = departures * arrival_share

# Calculate Self-Containment Index
self_containment_index = self_contained_trips / expected_self_contained_trips
self_containment_index.fillna(0, inplace=True)  # Handle division by zero

# Prepare to identify hot spots and cold spots
median_index = self_containment_index.median()
high_threshold = median_index
low_threshold = median_index

# Identify hot spots and cold spots
hot_spots = []
cold_spots = []

cold_spot_results = ', '.join([f"{borough} (LL, statistical method={value})" for borough, value in cold_spots])

adjacency_path = 'chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv'

# Read the datasets
bike_data = pd.read_csv(data_path)
adjacency_data = pd.read_csv(adjacency_path)

# Data Preparation
# Drop rows with missing values in relevant columns
bike_data = bike_data.dropna(subset=['StartBorough', 'EndBorough'])

# Calculate Departures and Self-contained trips
departures = bike_data.groupby('StartBorough').size()
self_contained_trips = bike_data[bike_data['StartBorough'] == bike_data['EndBorough']].groupby('StartBorough').size()

# Calculate total trips ending in each borough
total_trips_ending = bike_data.groupby('EndBorough').size()

# Calculate Arrival share
total_trips = bike_data.shape[0]
arrival_share = total_trips_ending / total_trips

# Calculate Expected self-contained trips
expected_self_contained_trips = departures * arrival_share

# Calculate Self-Containment Index
self_containment_index = self_contained_trips / expected_self_contained_trips
self_containment_index = self_containment_index.fillna(0)  # Handle division by zero

# Prepare a DataFrame for easier manipulation

    'Departures': departures,
    'Self_Contained_Trips': self_contained_trips,
    'Expected_Self_Contained_Trips': expected_self_contained_trips,
    'Self_Containment_Index': self_containment_index
}).fillna(0)

# Identify Hot Spots and Cold Spots
median_index = self_containment_df['Self_Containment_Index'].median()

    (self_containment_df['Self_Containment_Index'] > median_index) &
    (self_containment_df.index.isin(adjacency_data['borough'].unique())),

        'LL',  # Cold Spot
        'NA'
    )
)

# Identify neighboring boroughs

cold_spots = []

for borough in self_containment_df.index:
    if self_containment_df.loc[borough, 'Category'] == 'HH':

        if all(self_containment_df.loc[neighbor, 'Category'] == 'HH' for neighbor in neighbors if neighbor in self_containment_df.index):
